summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 14 backend tests passed (alert rules CRUD, uploads for CSV/LAS/invalid, WebSocket live feed streams telemetry). All frontend flows passed: LiveTicker STREAMING within seconds, all 6 metric cells rendering, 8 sidebar nav items present and functional, Case Upload with CSV successful (upload-result + uploaded-list populated), Alert Rules create/list/delete + triggered alerts populated after live feed ticks breached threshold, Case Detail download-pdf button triggers PDF download (CASE-001_report.pdf).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 630 lines with mixed responsibilities (routes + LiveHub + alert logic + models); consider splitting into routers/alerts.py, routers/uploads.py, live_hub.py for maintainability.

UPLOADED_CASES / ALERT_RULES / TRIGGERED_ALERTS are in-memory only - not persisted across backend restarts. Docstring says 'persisted to Mongo too' but no mongo writes occur. Either update the comment or add persistence.
LiveTicker.jsx useEffect has empty deps [] but references tick inside setPrev closure - initial prev is stale (works because functional setter used, minor).
LiveHub broadcasts every 2s to a global list without a lock; concurrent connect/disconnect could race. Acceptable for demo scale.
Alerts evaluate_alerts triggers on every live tick without dedup - a persistent breach spams alerts (~30/min for gt:1 rule). Consider rate-limiting per rule.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed alert rules and uploaded cases during testing (in-memory, cleared on backend restart).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (PDF, upload, alerts, live WebSocket) verified end-to-end. WebSocket URL wss://<host>/api/ws/live works via ingress. In-memory stores mean TEST_ data auto-clears on restart. If adding persistence, retest data survives supervisorctl restart backend.
